name: Frequent use of money service businesses, exchange houses or cash couriers alongside bank flows
description: Account activity regularly blends MSB, exchange house or cash courier movements with bank transfers.

sources.text: FATF, The Role of Hawala and Other Similar Service Providers in ML/TF (2013)
FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach for Money or Value Transfer Services (2016)
FATF, Money Laundering Through Money Remittance and Currency Exchange Providers (2010)
FATF, Professional Money Laundering (2018); FATF and Egmont, Concealment of Beneficial Ownership (2018)
Europol, European Union Serious and Organised Crime Threat Assessment (EU SOCTA) (specify 2021 or 2025)

links.name: Frequent use of money service businesses and exchange houses by the same account
links.ctx: Multiple MSB transactions and exchange houses, often similar amounts.

links.name: Frequent use of cash couriers or exchange houses alongside bank flows
links.ctx: Cash movement is blended with bank transfers via associated money service businesses.
links.fp: MSB use is common in some communities.
